question: Estimate the adoption of AI tutors in IIT-JEE / NEET prep among aspirants by 2027.
idealClarificationQuestions: AI tutor = personalized doubt-solving / problem generation app (PhysicsWallah AI, Doubtnut AI, Embibe AI)? Yes.
JEE + NEET aspirants combined: ~3M sit JEE Main, ~2.4M sit NEET annually = ~5M aspirants per year.
Active using AI tutoring features? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total aspirants × digital learning adoption × AI tool penetration.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, using any digital prep tool (paid or free): ~80% = 9.6M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Drivers to 2027: PhysicsWallah AI launch, Allen Digital AI, Embibe IIT-Madras AI, ChatGPT/Gemini for problem-solving used informally.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of which paying for premium AI features: ~15-20% = ~1.2-1.5M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, using any digital prep tool (paid or free)
Of which paying for premium AI features

calculationFlow: Multi-year prep cohort (Class 11 + 12 + droppers): ~12M total aspirant pool.
Of these, using any digital prep tool (paid or free): ~80% = 9.6M.
Of these, using AI-powered features (doubt-solving, personalized practice): ~50% in 2026 = ~5M.
Of which paying for premium AI features: ~15-20% = ~1.2-1.5M.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Of which paying for premium AI features: ~15-20% = ~1.2-1.5M.
